name: shuttle_arrival
trigger: end of a route leg at a stop station
mechanism: D1.move: final hop timeout, ARRIVE log

name: shuttle_availability
trigger: dispatcher hands the stopped shuttle to the station operation

name: workstation_operation_completion
trigger: station operation finished, shuttle may depart
mechanism: return of the operation handler (yield from)

name: station_release
trigger: shuttle starts moving to its already reserved next position

name: fanuc_input_transfer_complete
trigger: end of the UR10 input transfer

name: fanuc_assembly_complete
trigger: end of the FANUC robot + conveyor sequence
mechanism: D3.fanuc_branch: release of FANUC and Conveyor

name: fanuc_output_tray_ready
trigger: assembled tray at the UR10 pick position

name: output_transfer_synchronisation
trigger: shuttle back at WS6 AND tray ready

name: fanuc_cell_released
trigger: end of the UR10 transfer onto the shuttle

name: workpiece_setup_complete
mechanism: D5.op_ws9: release of Operator_WS9; shuttle then travels WS9 -> WS4 (D1)

name: prepared_workpieces
mechanism: tray 1 LOADED_6_MALE, tray 2 LOADED_6_FEMALE on the shuttle

name: assembly_prerequisites_verified
trigger: shuttle at WS4, before the UR3e starts

name: operation_command
trigger: next step of the production cycle

name: status_report
trigger: on request of the coordinator (end of run)

name: cycle_completion
trigger: shuttle back at the cycle start station (WS6 in DES v10.0)
mechanism: D1.complete_loop; dispatcher starts the next cycle
